prompt_text:
Match this appearance phrase against ALL anonymous person tiles in the image(s): "the person with a black halter-style leotard and a long, dark ponytail"
Every labeled tile is one different person from the same video; its two crops are held-out views. Labels and tile order do not reveal the intended target. A phrase may match none, one, or several people. Include ALL people who visibly satisfy the whole phrase in matches. Include in uncertain any plausible person for whom the views do not resolve an attribute, instead of assuming that person is a non-match. Do not pick a best match when several fit. A location or action does not distinguish appearance. Omitted labels mean clear non-matches.
Return {"matches":["P01"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"brief visual explanation"}. Valid labels: ["P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P07", "P08"].

message.content: {"matches":["P04"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"Only P04 consistently shows a black halter-style leotard with a long, dark ponytail across multiple views. Other individuals wear similar leotards but lack the long, dark ponytail or have different hairstyles (e.g., P01, P02, P03, P05, P06, P07, P08 have shorter hair or different styles). P04’s back and side views clearly show the halter neckline and long ponytail."}

parsed.reason: Only P04 consistently shows a black halter-style leotard with a long, dark ponytail across multiple views. Other individuals wear similar leotards but lack the long, dark ponytail or have different hairstyles (e.g., P01, P02, P03, P05, P06, P07, P08 have shorter hair or different styles). P04’s back and side views clearly show the halter neckline and long ponytail.
